source_scripts.title: Aethelgard Ep1 The Cataclysm 1285
source_scripts.content:
Title: AETHELGARD: THE BROKEN CROWNS - EPISODE 1: THE CATACLYSM
Credit: Written by Screenplay Vault
Author: CanonGuard Franchise Archives
Draft date: 1285 A.D.

EXT. BLOOD RIDGE GORGE - NIGHT - 1285

Black volcanic ash blankets the jagged ravines. Thunder rolls across the crimson sky. 

HIGH KING VALERIUS IV (43), clad in hammered black plate mail, stands atop the broken barricade. His knuckles whiten around the hilt of the ancestral broadsword.

Beside him, SERAPHINA THE BLIND PROPHET (65) clutches her bone rosary, blindfolded eyes turned toward the howling tempest.

HIGH KING VALERIUS IV
If the horde crosses the ridge tonight, Oakhaven burns before dawn! Lady Morwen, raise the obsidian ward!

LADY MORWEN (20) thrusts her silver stave into the blood-soaked soil. Azure sparks cascade along the rune carvings.

LADY MORWEN
The ley lines are fracturing, my King! The dragonfire is too fierce!

A monstrous roar tears through the mountain peaks. A torrent of white-hot dragonfire descends from the black clouds.

Valerius raises the sacred royal sword to intercept the blast.

HIGH KING VALERIUS IV
Stand firm behind the steel of our ancestors!

The flame impacts the blade with apocalyptic force. The ancient runes flare blinding violet--then CRACK.

SERAPHINA
(screaming over the gale)
The prophecy is severed! The steel of Eldor cannot endure the flame!

The SUN-FORGED BLADE OF ELDOR shatters into a dozen jagged, molten fragments. Liquid iron rains into the mud, hissing into steam. The hilt melts away in Valerius's armored gauntlet.

HIGH KING VALERIUS IV
(staring in horror at his empty hands)
The blade... the Sun-Forged Blade is destroyed. It is gone forever!

Valerius drops the scorched iron tang into the ash. Lady Morwen pulls the King back as the ridge collapses into ruin.

source_scripts.title: Aethelgard Ep2 The Frost Tomb 1294
source_scripts.content:
Title: AETHELGARD: THE BROKEN CROWNS - EPISODE 2: THE FROST TOMB
Credit: Written by Screenplay Vault
Author: CanonGuard Franchise Archives
Draft date: 1294 A.D.

INT. FROSTPEAK ENCHANTED AMBER VAULT - DAWN - 1292

Massive pillars of glacial ice support the vaulted ceiling. In the center of the chamber rests the CRYOGENIC AMBER TOMB, radiating an unnatural sub-zero mist.

LADY MORWEN (27) checks the glowing runic seals carved into the amber casing.

PRINCE KAELEN (22), his skin pale as snow, lying inside the crystalline sarcophagus. Dark necrotic veins pulse slowly along his throat.

LADY MORWEN
The Wyrm-poison will reach his heart in hours unless we arrest his pulse. Prince Kaelen must enter deep stasis.

PRINCE KAELEN
(weakly, barely audible)
How long must I sleep, Morwen?

LADY MORWEN
Until the grand celestial alignment in the year 1320. Twenty-eight winters you shall sleep in suspended animation, undisturbed by mortal warfare.

Lady Morwen depresses the twin frost runes. The amber lid slides shut. Frost crystals bloom across the glass. Kaelen's breathing ceases as total stasis takes hold.

INT. THE RED MIRE FORTRESS - DUNGEON - DUSK - 1294

Chains clatter against stone. LORD COMMANDER BRANOK (44) is dragged before the tribunal.

GRAND INQUISITOR MALAKOR (36) holds the glowing EYE OF THE VOID ORB between black leather gloves.

GRAND INQUISITOR MALAKOR
Lord Commander Branok, for treason against the Crown, surrender the Void Orb to the holy inquisition!

LORD COMMANDER BRANOK
(blood spitting onto the flagstones)
No inquisitor will ever enslave the souls of the dead with this cursed stone!

Branok breaks his chains with a surge of desperate fury, lunges forward, and slams his iron-plated war hammer directly into the Eye of the Void Orb!

The orb detonates with an ear-splitting screech, splintering into thousands of lifeless obsidian pebbles. The necromantic light vanishes forever.

GRAND INQUISITOR MALAKOR
Guards, seize him! The relic is annihilated!

Malakor's guards drive halberds into Branok's chest. Lord Commander Branok collapses to the stone floor, dead.

MALAKOR (CONT'D)
Record it in the ledger. Year 1294. Commander Branok is dead, and the Void Orb is permanently broken.

# STORY BIBLE: Aethelgard: The Broken Crowns
Genre: Grimdark Fantasy / High Magic
Era: 1240–1325 (Aethelgard High Annals)
Setting: The Seven Shattered Realms of Aethelgard

## Dramatis Personae (Character Canon)
- Character: High King Valerius IV (Born: 1242, Died: 1298, Status: Dead) - The Iron Sovereign of Oakhaven. Assassinated during the 1298 Winter Solstice feast.
- Character: Lady Morwen of House Karst (Born: 1265, Died: 1340, Status: Alive) - Arch-Mage of the Obsidian Spire and master of protective wards.
- Character: Lord Commander Branok (Born: 1250, Died: 1294, Status: Dead) - Blood Shield of Karst. Executed after the siege of Red Mire in 1294.
- Character: Prince Kaelen the Frozen (Born: 1270, Stasis: 1292-1320, Status: Stasis) - Heir to Frostpeak. Sealed in cryo-enchanted amber stasis from 1292 to 1320.
- Character: Seraphina the Blind Prophet (Born: 1220, Died: 1289, Status: Dead) - Seer of the Weeping Mire whose visions foretold the shattering of royal relics.
- Character: Grand Inquisitor Malakor (Born: 1258, Died: 1318, Status: Alive) - Ruthless keeper of the Red Ledger and high law enforcer.

## Relic and Artifact Continuity
- Relic: Sun-Forged Blade of Eldor (Forged: 1180, Shattered in: 1285, Status: Destroyed) - Sacred ancestral broadsword of the High Kings. Vaporized into molten slag during the Cataclysm of Blood Ridge in 1285.
- Relic: Crown of the Seven Wyrms (Forged: 1210, Melted in: 1299, Status: Destroyed) - Golden circlet melted in dragonfire during the fall of Highkeep in 1299.
- Relic: Eye of the Void Orb (Created: 1235, Destroyed in: 1294, Status: Destroyed) - Obsidian sphere used to channel necromantic ley lines. Crushed to dust by Branok in 1294.
- Relic: Amulet of the First Archon (Forged: 1150, Status: Active) - Preserved safely in the vaults of the Obsidian Spire.

## Universal Axioms & Physical Invariants
- Rule: Any spellcaster channeling raw blood sorcery without an inscribed silver ward ring suffers instantaneous arterial combustion.
- Rule: Frost Drakes cannot breathe combustion flame and perish within three minutes if exposed to desert heat exceeding 40 degrees Celsius.
- Rule: No sovereign bearing the Curse of the Weeping Mark may touch the Iron Sept scepter without disintegrating into obsidian ash.

Frost Drakes cannot breathe combustion flame and perish within three minutes if exposed to desert heat exceeding 40 degrees Celsius.
No sovereign bearing the Curse of the Weeping Mark may touch the Iron Sept scepter without disintegrating into obsidian ash.

source_scripts.title: Hyperion Ep1 The Ganymede Breach 2175
source_scripts.content:
Title: PROJECT HYPERION: 2180 - EPISODE 1: THE GANYMEDE BREACH
Credit: Written by Screenplay Vault
Author: CanonGuard Franchise Archives
Draft date: 2175 A.D.

INT. GANYMEDE SUB-SURFACE DOCK 4 - NIGHT - 2175

Red emergency sirens strobe across the massive titanium bulkheads. Decompression klaxons wail.

CHIEF ENGINEER MARCUS VANCE (37), soot smeared across his EVA suit, frantically types override codes into the primary console.

Beside him stands DR. ARIS THORNE (Model AX-9), synthetic chrome skin reflecting the pulsing crimson warning indicators.

DR. ARIS THORNE
Antimatter magnetic field containment is decaying at 4.2 percent per second. The Hyperion Drive has entered runaway resonance!

CHIEF ENGINEER MARCUS VANCE
Eject the core into the Jovian gravity well! We cannot let another disaster happen like Phobos in 2172!

DR. ARIS THORNE
Admiral Teresa Cruz went down with Phobos Station when her hull breached. If this core detonates inside Dock 4, all twelve thousand colonists will follow her to the grave!

Vance pulls the manual emergency jettison lever. Sparks burst from the hydraulic couplings.

The blast doors shudder. Inside the containment chamber, the HYPERION DARK-MATTER DRIVE flares into a blinding sapphire vortex.

DR. ARIS THORNE (CONT'D)
Containment failure is absolute. The core is undergoing subatomic vaporization!

A deafening shockwave rocks the station. The sapphire vortex collapses into a blinding pinprick, consuming the entire drive array.

When the smoke clears, only a scorched, empty magnetic cradle remains. The Hyperion Dark-Matter Drive has been completely vaporized.

CHIEF ENGINEER MARCUS VANCE
(coughing into his respirator)
The drive... the prototype drive is completely destroyed. Record it in the naval archives. Year 2175. The Hyperion program is dead.

source_scripts.title: Hyperion Ep2 Cold Sleep Transit 2178
source_scripts.content:
Title: PROJECT HYPERION: 2180 - EPISODE 2: COLD SLEEP TRANSIT
Credit: Written by Screenplay Vault
Author: CanonGuard Franchise Archives
Draft date: 2178 A.D.

INT. USC BOREALIS - CRYOGENIC BAY - 2178

The steady, rhythmic hum of liquid helium pumps fills the silent chamber. Rows of frosted cylindrical pods line the dark corridor.

DR. ARIS THORNE (Model AX-9) steps silently along the catwalk, checking biometric readouts on a handheld diagnostic pad.

Thorne stops before POD 09. Through the condensation-frosted quartz glass, the frozen face of SPECIAL AGENT GABRIEL CROSS (33) is visible. His eyelids are sealed behind a silver retinal sheath.

A digital holographic readout hovers over the pod:
SUBJECT: SPECIAL AGENT GABRIEL CROSS
STATUS: DEEP CRYOGENIC SUSPENSION (COMMENCED 2165)
AUTOMATED REVIVAL SCHEDULED: 2190 A.D.
CURRENT TRANSIT TIME: 13 YEARS ELAPSED / 12 YEARS REMAINING

DR. ARIS THORNE
(recording audio log)
Ship Log: Stardate 2178. Dr. Thorne reporting. USC Borealis has crossed the Saturn orbital boundary on conventional ion cruise.

Thorne taps the stasis pod status panel.

DR. ARIS THORNE (CONT'D)
Agent Cross remains in stable deep-freeze stasis within Pod 09. Core temperature negative two-hundred-fourteen Celsius. Neural engrams fully frozen. No waking consciousness will occur until the year 2190.

# STORY BIBLE: Project Hyperion: 2180
Genre: Hard Sci-Fi / Cyberpunk
Era: 2140–2195 (Sol Planetary Wars)
Setting: Sol Outer Rim, Mars Shipyards & Jovian Colonies

## Dramatis Personae (Character Canon)
- Character: Admiral Teresa Cruz (Born: 2125, Died: 2172, Status: Dead) - Supreme Commander of the United Sol Fleet. Killed in the 2172 Phobos orbital decompression catastrophe.
- Character: Chief Engineer Marcus Vance (Born: 2138, Died: 2205, Status: Alive) - Chief quantum propulsion engineer aboard USC Vanguard.
- Character: Special Agent Gabriel Cross (Born: 2145, Stasis: 2165-2190, Status: Stasis) - Cyber-infiltrator frozen in stasis pod 09 aboard USC Borealis from 2165 until 2190.
- Character: Dr. Aris Thorne (Born: 2150, Died: 2210, Status: Alive) - Synthetic android model AX-9 serving as Chief Science Officer.
- Character: Commander David Sterling (Born: 2130, Died: 2168, Status: Dead) - Leader of the Helium-3 lunar uprising, executed in 2168.

## Technology & Relic Continuity
- Relic: Hyperion Dark-Matter Drive (Built: 2155, Destroyed in: 2175, Status: Destroyed) - Experimental FTL warp engine. Overheated and atomized in the Ganymede Breach of 2175.
- Relic: Quantum Neural Cipher (Created: 2160, Destroyed in: 2172, Status: Destroyed) - Military decryption keycard atomized during the Phobos Station hull breach.
- Relic: Titanium AI Core Theta (Created: 2152, Destroyed in: 2169, Status: Destroyed) - Rogue AI mainframe melted in plasma acid.
- Relic: Mark-IV Exosuit Rig (Built: 2162, Status: Active) - Standard heavy EVA pressurized suit.

## Universal Axioms & Physical Invariants
- Rule: Unpressurized exposure to Titan liquid methane surface causes cellular flash-freezing in less than four seconds without thermal EVA insulation.
- Rule: Direct neural interface with unshielded hyper-drives causes permanent cortical synapse meltdown.
- Rule: Armed orbital bombardment vessels are strictly prohibited within the Martian Demilitarized Lunar Arc under the Sol Defense Treaty.

CHRONOVERSE.title: Episode 4: The Solaria Core (1960)
CHRONOVERSE.content:
Title: THE QUANTUM HORIZON - EPISODE 4: THE SOLARIA CORE
Credit: Written by Screenplay Vault
Author: CanonGuard Archives
Draft date: 1960 A.D.

EXT. SOLARIA CORE REACTOR - NIGHT - 1960

Liquid magma surges through subterranean fissures. Alarm sirens wail in descending minor thirds.

KARA (30) clutches the radiant golden SUNSTONE in both blistered palms at the core precipice.

VIKTOR (30) steps out from the access gantry, arm outstretched.

VIKTOR
Kara! Do not drop the stone! The thermal pressure will atomize the crystal matrix forever!

KARA
The overload cannot be reversed, Viktor! If we do not atomize the stone, the planetary crust will shatter!

Kara drops the Sunstone into the fissure. White-hot plasma engulfs it, reducing the artifact to subatomic vapor.

KARA (CONT'D)
It is gone. Forever.

CHRONOVERSE.title: Episode 7: Cold Protocol 42 (1989)
CHRONOVERSE.content:
Title: THE QUANTUM HORIZON - EPISODE 7: COLD PROTOCOL 42
Credit: Written by Screenplay Vault
Author: CanonGuard Archives
Draft date: 1989 A.D.

INT. SIBERIAN RESEARCH BUNKER 42 - CRYOGENIC VAULT - NIGHT - 1989

Frost crystals coat the reinforced plexiglass portals. Sub-zero nitrogen mist rolls across the grating.

VIKTOR (59) climbs into Stasis Pod 04, his temporal mutant engrams pulsing blue.

HEAD SCIENTIST
Cryogenic freezing cycle confirmed. Stasis window locked from 1975 to 1995.

VIKTOR
Make sure the locks hold. If I awaken before 1995, the temporal paradox will collapse our timeline.

The hydraulic seal hisses shut. Nitrogen mist blankets the pod. Viktor's eyes freeze into motionless stasis.

CHRONOVERSE.title: Episode 9: The Geneva Collapse (1994)
CHRONOVERSE.content:
Title: THE QUANTUM HORIZON - EPISODE 9: THE GENEVA COLLAPSE
Credit: Written by Screenplay Vault
Author: CanonGuard Archives
Draft date: 1994 A.D.

INT. GENEVA COLLIDER COMPLEX - LAB THREE - NIGHT - 1994

Sparks shower from the magnetic containment housing. The experimental QUANTUM DRIVE hums with deafening oscillation.

DR. SARAH
The primary harmonic field is rupturing! The Quantum Drive cannot maintain structural stability!

LEAD RESEARCHER
Emergency jettison is unresponsive!

A blinding sphere of cerulean plasma erupts from the casing. The Quantum Drive shatters into billions of glowing subatomic ions, completely disintegrating the containment cradle.

DR. SARAH (CONT'D)
It's vaporized! The Quantum Drive was completely destroyed! Zero recoverable fragments!

GALACTIC_IMPERIUM.title: Chapter 1: The Valos Conquest (2140 A.D.)
GALACTIC_IMPERIUM.content:
Title: GALACTIC IMPERIUM - CHAPTER 1: THE VALOS CONQUEST
Credit: Imperial Archives
Draft date: 2140 A.D.

EXT. VALOS PRIME ORBIT - 2140

Ten thousand dreadnoughts blot out the binary suns.

GRAND INQUISITOR KAEL (32) stands upon the command bridge, overlooking the captured orbital shipyards.

GRAND INQUISITOR KAEL
From this day forth, the Valos shipyards belong solely to the Imperium. Inquisitor rule is absolute across the sector.

GALACTIC_IMPERIUM.title: Chapter 8: The Singularity Fall (2175 A.D.)
GALACTIC_IMPERIUM.content:
Title: GALACTIC IMPERIUM - CHAPTER 8: THE SINGULARITY FALL
Credit: Imperial Archives
Draft date: 2175 A.D.

INT. IMPERIAL DREADNOUGHT - CORE CHAMBER - 2175

The KYBER SINGULARITY CORE flares uncontrollable violet radiation across the containment catwalks.

LADY SERAPHINA
The singularity is uncontained! It is consuming its own housing!

SERAPHINA
Eject the core into the black hole!

The Kyber Singularity Core collapses inward under gravity shear, vanishing into the event horizon, destroyed permanently in 2175.

MYTHOS_REALM.title: Scroll 3: The Blood Ridge Cataclysm (1285 A.D.)
MYTHOS_REALM.content:
Title: MYTHOS REALM - SCROLL 3: BLOOD RIDGE
Credit: Royal Annals of Eldor
Draft date: 1285 A.D.

EXT. BLOOD RIDGE GORGE - 1285

Dragonfire rains from the dark sky. The AETHELGARD BLADE is struck by ancient wyrmfire, shattering into thousands of molten shards across the volcanic stone.

QUEEN MORWEN
The ancient blade is broken! The steel of Eldor is no more!
